Description.Name: WarperJawa
Description.Details: The pilot was originally born on New Avalon to a minor noble house of the Federated Suns. Barely a barony at the time in which she grew up, Warper was still always feeling like there was something more. Something that she was missing. Eventually it came down to a choice. Stay and become a politician, dancing in the viper pits; or strike her own way. Without further hesitation, she joined up with the Word of Blake. She had read much about Jerome Blake and though their policies could be extreme; the excitement of getting off planet and repairing HPGs set something moving in her. That lasted well, for a time, in the Security Division of Mu Iota. Yet, even there she felt unfulfilled after 8 years and decided to leave in what was probably the worst way one could. By waiting until they were taking care of an HPG Installation in Taurian Space. That night she waited, then snuck into the mech bay. They did not have a Raven, which is what she trained with extensively via sim at home, but they did have a modified Nagual. Figuring it cannot be much different, she set the launch sequence and 'Oh No! Its so terrible I am trapped inside when I was simply playing around like an entitled noble!' Sad to say, the Nagual did not survive the jump well, but she did. Now stuck out in Taurian Space with the skeletal remains of a Word of Blake medium mech, she has decided to make the best of it. Finding a fellow pilot who she got along with, Soontide, Warper and he set about rebuilding the damaged medium with scraps of salvage to make it what is arguably the worst designed mech in history. That mech's plans of hers? Made for DFA all day... if she can even find the parts.... COMMUNITY CONTENT
